title: Unprotected Left Turn: Wait for Oncoming Traffic
intro: The blue car is coming toward you. A person is crossing the street you want to enter.
watchCaption: Oncoming traffic is close. A pedestrian is in the crossing.
safeCaption: Car and pedestrian clear; then you turn left.
unsafeCaption: Your turn would cut across approaching traffic.
safeFeedback: The oncoming car and the person both pass before you turn left.

feedback.turn-now: Your left turn crossed the blue car’s lane. Wait for oncoming traffic and the person crossing.
feedback.watch-pedestrian: The person cleared, but the blue car had not. Both paths need to be clear before you turn.
